name: National Cyber Security Strategies: Practical Guide on Development and Execution (2012)
description: National Cyber Security Strategies: Practical Guide on Development and Execution (December 2012). ENISA lifecycle methodology guide for designing, implementing, governing, and evaluating National Cyber Security Strategies (NCSS).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by EU Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) (enisa.europa.eu) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for EU Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) (enisa.europa.eu).
